crossRefs.note: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth…
There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the…
He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over, and could in no way…
Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.
Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works…

translations.web: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
translations.bsb: In a loud voice Paul called out, “Stand up on your feet!” And the man jumped up and began to walk.
translations.kjv: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
translations.asv: said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped up and walked.
